scope: read-only local source and prior-receipt diagnosis

findings.rootCause: The attempted Return to Setup route requires the existing administrator plaintext; Config/admin.txt stores a salted hash.
findings.supportedRoute: Join as blank-password Gamemaster, then use Settings -> Manage Modules inside the running world; M279 proves this route.
findings.adminPasswordMutation: The v4 credential was not inspected, changed, deleted, or retried after the bounded M1206 failure.
findings.sourceEvidence: Foundry dist/core/config.mjs loads Config/admin.txt and only initializes --adminPassword when no administrator password exists.
findings.recoveryDisposition: Authorize one fresh M1206 in-world Manage Modules recovery; do not create a new fixture or return to Setup.
